Description: Adds configurable procedural noise to the current biome field before filters are evaluated.

Sections.Name: Noise
Sections.Label: Noise
Sections.Description: Noise source, scale, and layered detail controls.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic pattern used by the base-noise generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible noise layout.

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Selects the noise family used for every base-noise octave.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Controls the size of the shared noise features.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create smaller, more closely spaced features.

Params.Name: Lacunarity
Params.Label: Noise Lacunarity
Params.Description: Sets the frequency multiplier between successive noise layers.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values make each octave add finer detail more quickly.

Params.Name: Persistence
Params.Label: Noise Persistence
Params.Description: Sets how much amplitude each successive noise layer retains.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values keep more high-frequency detail.

Params.Name: NoiseOctaves
Params.Label: Noise Octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many layers are evaluated from the octave-strength profile.
Params.Tooltip: More layers add detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends the sampling domain before evaluating the noise.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to break up smooth, predictable terrain contours.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Moves feature points inside cellular noise cells.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley noise.

Sections.Name: Octaves
Sections.Label: Octave Strengths
Sections.Description: Controls the contribution of each individual noise layer.

Params.Name: OctaveStrengths
Params.Label: Octave Strengths
Params.Description: Controls the contribution of each individual noise layer.

Sections.Name: Blend
Sections.Label: Blend
Sections.Description: Controls how the generated noise is combined with the current biome field.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the amplitude of the generated noise.
Params.Tooltip: Negative values invert the noise contribution.

Params.Name: Influence
Params.Label: Influence
Params.Description: Controls how strongly this generator contributes to the final biome output.
Params.Tooltip: Set to zero to temporarily disable the contribution without changing its settings.

Params.Name: MixMethod
Params.Label: Mix Method
Params.Description: Selects how the generated noise is blended with the source field.

Params.Name: AutoUseSeedTexture
Params.Label: Use Seed Texture
Params.Description: Uses the generated seed texture when one is available.
Params.Tooltip: Disable to use the inspector seed and coordinate field alone.

Sections.Name: Transform
Sections.Label: Transform
Sections.Description: Controls the sampling offset and optional terrain-dependent remapping.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Label: Offset
Params.Description: Offsets the noise sampling position in 3D space.
Params.Tooltip: Move through the noise field without changing its scale.

Params.Name: TransformFactor
Params.Label: Transform Factor
Params.Description: Chooses the terrain factor used to remap the noise.

Params.Name: SlopeSmoothingRadius
Params.Label: Slope Smoothing Radius
Params.Description: Sets the radius used to smooth slope sampling.

Params.Name: SlopeSamplingRadius
Params.Label: Slope Sampling Radius
Params.Description: Controls how far the generator samples when measuring slope.

Params.Name: TransformRange
Params.Label: Transform Range
Params.Description: Remaps the chosen transform factor into this normalized range.
Params.Tooltip: The range is sorted before the smooth remap is applied.

Sections.Name: Filtering
Sections.Label: Filtering
Sections.Description: Optional preprocessing for terrain-derived slope measurements.

Params.Name: UseGaussianPreFilter
Params.Label: Use Gaussian Pre-filter
Params.Description: Applies a Gaussian pre-filter before slope samples are evaluated.
Params.Tooltip: Use this to reduce fine height-field noise in slope-driven noise.
